description: Prepare a new WeInc website from a description of the business. Returns a link; nothing is built or charged until the person opens it and confirms in their browser. Put everything you know into `brief`: business name, what they do, location, services, audience, tone, pages wanted, contact details. Optionally pass `template_id` from find_templates. The build starts only after the person confirms on that page.

brief.description: Full description of the business and the website wanted.

name: start_website
title: Start a new website
